notes.title: About game forums on Steam.
notes.content:
If you find any bugs/glitches, even if they are small, let us know about them by posting them on the Bugs Report forums.

If you are stuck in the game or want to share some knowledge or secrets make sure to use the Secrets / Puzzles forum chat with other players and find the "secreest" secrets!

If you need another forum to be created or want to share some thoughts please message us on doublethoughtsgames@gmail.com or use reddit forum! http://reddit.com/r/TheJourneyGame

notes.title: The Journey: Double Thoughts Story.
notes.content:
Hello! We are Double Thoughts Games, an Argentinian indie game team formed by 2 people.

Tomas Gonzalez (Game Director/Programmer/Game Designer) 19 Years old.

Martin Pilaszek (Artwork/Game Designer) 16 Years old.

Over the past three years, Double Thoughts Games has been working on
The Journey: Bob’s Story.

At Double Thoughts Games, we love exploration games, we took a lot of inspiration from Knytt Series and The Great Work by Nifflas and with The Journey: Bob’s Story, we wanted to contribute our little grain of sand to
the genre from those games and give our best to give the player a new different experience.

We tried our hardest to make The Journey: Bob's Story the best game that we could've made it was a hard process since we never had any budget whatsoever.

So we hope you love this game as we do! and don't forget to leave feedback /review, even if it's negative, we love to hear from our players to improve the quality of our games.

Thank you.

Double Thoughts Games.


PS: For bug reports use the steam forum, or send an email to doublethoughtsgames@gmail.com
